meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1528 (data provider DP3), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Final figures where published, else provisional. Amounts in ₹ crore; counts as numbers; ratios in per cent, as each row's label says. 84 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2022-03-31, 2023-03-31, 2024-03-31, 2019-03-31 and other dates) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right.
